findings: NIKL answer supports declarative/interrogative uses in addition to directives and composition; exact imperative allomorphy, examples, and contrastive register claims remain open.
limitations: La afirmación central “-(으)세요 is used as a polite imperative/directive but is not only imperative” no queda sustentada en toda su extensión junto con la morfología, matices y ejemplos materiales de la ficha.
